description:
Job Title : UI Full Stack Developer
Location : San Jose, CA
Duration : Contract

Job description :

Total Experience of 8+ years with 5+yrs experience in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, LESS, NodeJS, AngularJS, JQuery 
• 5+yrs experience in Core Java 
• Concurrency, distributed programming model and service architectures, data structures, collections, multithreading, etc
• Hands-on experience in Linux, Windows OS 
• Working knowledge in version control systems such as Git 
• Working knowledge in Maven 
• Experience in Shell script, Python is a plus 
• Basic knowledge in networking concepts and protocols such as Cisco Switches, Routers, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, Telnet, FTP, SSH, SNMP etc is a must 
• Experience in Industrial Protocols such as CIP, PROFINET, MODBUS etc is a plus 
• Experience in YANG data modelling is a plus 
• Strong communication and leadership skills are essential. Must be a strong team player and have excellent collaborating skills 
• Experience with Cisco tools is a plus 
• Working experience with test tools like traffic analyzers (e.g., Wireshark) and traffic generation tools (e.g., Smartbits, Ixia) 
• Experience in manual & automated testing and writing test plans is a plus

Mandatory: LinkedIn presence and for verification share 2 good References from your last two projects.

If you are not interested in the role or if now isn’t a great time for a move, just let me know if I can help in the future.
Thanks for your time,



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
